# Draft:King Tut's tomb:What was found in it?

King Tut
Tutankhamun was 9 years old when he was first crowned king and died at the age of 14. Scientists suspect that he had died from a serious leg injury. Since he has died at such a young age, his burial had to be a swift one. This was a good thing, since it prevented robberies. Although it's somewhat hidden location, there have been 2 robberies over time, but majority of the treasures have been concealed.
